rules.description: Under the Procurement Act 2023 s.53(1), above-threshold public contracts subject to PA23 must publish a Contract Details Notice within 30 days of contract signature. The 30-day clock runs from the award date (proxy for signature, per Cabinet Office guidance — OCDS exposes the award date, not the signature).
rules.name: Procurement Act 2023 s.53(1)

rules.description: Verifies that contracts above defined value thresholds were approved by an appropriately senior delegated authority level in line with procurement governance controls.
rules.name: Delegated authority threshold

rules.description: Supplier must not appear on any published sanctions / debarment list. Composite — UK PA23 Schedule 6 + EU 2014/24/EU Art. 57 + FAR 9.4.
rules.name: Sanctions list check

rules.description: A conflict-of-interest declaration field must exist on every procurement decision. Composite — UK PA23 s.81 + EU 2014/24/EU Art. 24 + FAR 3.101.
rules.name: Conflict of interest declaration required

rules.description: Above-threshold contracts require open competition unless a direct-award justification under PA23 s.41 applies. Composite — UK PA23 s.19 + s.41 + SI 2024/692 reg. 26 + EU 2014/24/EU thresholds + US FAR.
rules.name: Open competition required above threshold

rules.description: Contract modifications must not exceed 50% of the original contract value. Composite — UK PA23 s.74 (substantial modification grounds) + Schedule 8 para 8 (50% value cap) + SI 2024/692 reg. 40 + EU 2014/24/EU Art. 72.
rules.name: Modification value cap
